top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new pharmacological principle, catalytic event-driven removal of a target by designed heterobifunctional molecules that recruit E3 ligases, built on designed chemistry (E3 ligands, linkers, ternary-complex cooperativity) and reproduced independently for two decades. Crews and Deshaies supply the founding concept and first demonstration, and Ciulli the structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex work that made PROTACs a rational design discipline. The citation is narrow and states exactly what it covers. P002 (Handa instead of Ciulli) is a close second, since cereblon is clinically validated but it merges two lineages; P001 is the cleanest-credit mature fallback; P005 and P004 follow.
